basic_profile.bio: G'day! I'm a passionate gamer from Melbourne, Australia. I've been gaming since I was a kid, and I love everything from first-person shooters to strategy games. I'm also a bit of a tech enthusiast, always looking to optimize my gaming setup. When I'm not gaming, you can find me researching military history or spending time with my two adorable dogs. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work. I'm currently working as a systems analyst in a mid-sized tech company. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to travel and explore new places.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science from the University of Melbourne. My love for technology and gaming led me to self-teach various aspects of hardware configuration and optimization. I'm also quite knowledgeable about military history, thanks to my personal interest and extensive reading.
